refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refreshInterval.description: How often to refresh device status (30-3600 seconds)

cognitoRefreshInterval.title: Cognito Refresh Interval (seconds)
cognitoRefreshInterval.description: How often to check pypura for updated Cognito IDs (0 to disable)

forceNightlightOffOnDiffuserOn.title: Force Nightlight Off When Diffuser Turns On
forceNightlightOffOnDiffuserOn.description: If enabled, the plugin will send a nightlight off command right after turning on a diffuser.

nightlightSyncMode.title: Nightlight Sync Mode
nightlightSyncMode.description: Controls how the nightlight accessory stays in sync. 'diffuser' mirrors diffuser on/off, 'device' uses Pura API state, and 'homekit' only changes when you toggle it in HomeKit.
